definitions.explanation: a Japanese rice bowl dish consisting of sliced beef and onion simmered in a sweet-savory sauce, served over rice

examples.japanese: {牛丼|ぎゅうどん}を{注文|ちゅうもん}する。
{昼|ひる}ごはんに{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I had a beef bowl for lunch.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}の{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}は{肉|にく}がたっぷり{乗|の}っている。
examples.english: The beef bowl at this restaurant is generously topped with meat.

notes:
JAPANESE FAST FOOD:
{牛丼|ぎゅうどん} is one of Japan's most popular fast food dishes. Major chains like {吉野家|よしのや}, すき{家|や}, and {松屋|まつや} serve it nationwide at affordable prices.

ORDERING OPTIONS:
- {並盛|なみもり} - regular size
- {大盛|おおもり} - large size
- {特盛|とくもり} - extra large
- {玉子|たまご} - with egg
- {味噌汁|みそしる}セット - with miso soup set

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牛丼|ぎゅうどん}を{食|た}べる - eat beef bowl
- {牛丼|ぎゅうどん}を{注文|ちゅうもん}する - order beef bowl
- {牛丼|ぎゅうどん}{一筋|ひとすじ} - devoted to beef bowls

RELATED WORDS:
- {豚丼|ぶたどん} - pork bowl
- {親子丼|おやこどん} - chicken and egg bowl
- {天丼|てんどん} - tempura bowl
- カツ{丼|どん} - pork cutlet bowl

cross_references.label: beef (or pork) and egg rice bowl
